text: ‘Poverty in developing societies is the main factor contributing to the growth in global crime.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Globalisation has failed to benefit developing societies.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Audiences are the main influence on the content of the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘There is clear evidence that the media has a direct impact on human behaviour.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion helps the ruling class maintain social control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Growth in support for new religious movements and New Age ideas shows that religion has lost
its social significance.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
